fix: apply disp_trim to all format_meter return paths (#1658)

format_meter had six return statements but only two applied disp_trim,
so bar_format outputs without a {bar} placeholder (e.g. bar_format=
"{desc}") and the no-total default stats line ignored ncols/
dynamic_ncols and could overflow the terminal width, causing wrapping
and display corruption.

Wrap the remaining return paths in disp_trim using the existing
`disp_trim(x, ncols) if ncols else x` guard so ncols=0 and ncols=None
(the sentinels for 'no bar' / 'unknown width') keep their prior
behaviour. Add regression coverage in test_format_meter.

fix: apply disp_trim to all format_meter return paths

format_meter has 6 return statements but only 2 applied disp_trim
when ncols is set. This meant custom bar_format without {bar} and
the no-total stats-only path would not respect ncols, producing
output wider than the terminal.

Now all return paths (except ncols==0 which is intentionally compact)
apply disp_trim consistently.

logging: inherit output stream from existing handler

When using the logging redirection, logs will currently always be printed
to stdout, while the logging module default is to print to stderr.

Fix this by trying to inherit the stream from the existing handler, like
the code already does for the formatter.

Consider the following example:

    import logging
    import time

    from tqdm.contrib.logging import tqdm_logging_redirect

    log = logging.getLogger()
    log.warning("start")

    with tqdm_logging_redirect(range(int(4))) as pbar:
        for i in pbar:
            time.sleep(0.1)
            log.warning(f"Step {i}")

    log.warning("done")

Running this while redirecting stdout (`$ python3 log.py > /dev/null`)
without this patch will print:

    $ venv/bin/python log.py > /dev/null
    start
    100%|████████████████████████████████████████████| 4/4 [00:00<00:00,  9.87it/s]
    done

After this patch:

    $ venv/bin/python log.py > /dev/null
    start
    Step 0
    Step 1
    Step 2
    Step 3
    100%|████████████████████████████████████████████| 4/4 [00:00<00:00,  9.83it/s]
    done

Signed-off-by: Steffan Karger <steffan.karger@fox-it.com>
